scope: Unhooked product analyze call on frozen actual landscape RGB
timedIncludes: SemanticLightAnalyzer.analyze: product preparation, native inference, fusion, object detection, light/sky observation and DTO construction; lazy model loading and product asset validation on cold first call
timedExcludes: Fixture reads and fixture checksums, bitmap creation, PSS sampling, test correctness checks, binary/JSON writes, video decoding, camera/UI and whole-session accumulation
coldDefinition: First analyze on fresh AppServices/model sessions; OS page cache, runtime/JIT and device thermal state are not reset
warmProtocol: First actual frame repeated once after cold; remaining seven frames once each, same analyzer; no discarded timing runs
